echo A; rg -l "getServerErrorFromUnknown" --glob '!graphify-out' ; echo B; rg -l "convertErrorWithCodeToTRPCError|toTRPCError" --glob '!graphify-out'; echo C; rg -l "oauth2-error.service|OAuth2ErrorService" --glob '!graphify-out'; echo D; rg -l "atoms-oauth2.controller|AtomsOAuth2Controller" --glob '!graphify-out'; echo E; rg -l "generateAuthCode.handler|getClientForAuthorization.handler|oAuth/refreshToken/route|oauth/token/route|from \"\./route\"|\.\./route\"" --glob '!graphify-out' | head -30; echo F; rg -l "libraries/errors|platform-libraries/errors" --glob '!graphify-out'

rg -n "getServerErrorFromUnknown" packages/lib/errors.ts apps/web/app/api/cron/calendar-subscriptions-cleanup/__tests__/route.test.ts apps/web/app/api/auth/signup/handlers/*.ts packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts packages/platform/libraries/errors.ts apps/api/v2/src/platform/bookings/2024-04-15/controllers/bookings.controller.ts apps/api/v2/src/platform/bookings/2024-08-13/services/booking-attendees.service.ts | cut -c1-200; echo ---; rg -n "getHttpStatusCode" packages/platform/libraries/errors.ts; ls apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/*/ apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/*/__tests__ packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/oAuth/ 2>&1; rg -l "refreshToken/route|getClientForAuthorization" --glob '!graphify-out' | head -20; rg -l "defaultResponder\b|defaultResponderForAppDir|onErrorHandler|errorConversionMiddleware" --glob '!graphify-out' | wc -l

rg -n "getServerErrorFromUnknown\(" --glob '!graphify-out' -l; echo ---; rg -n "getServerErrorFromUnknown|convertErrorWithCodeToTRPCError" packages/trpc/server/onErrorHandler.ts packages/trpc/server/middlewares/errorConversionMiddleware.ts | head; echo ---; rg -n "\b(handleAuthorizeError|handleTokenError|handleClientError)\b" -l; echo; rg -n "generateAuthCodeHandler|getClientForAuthorizationHandler" -l; rg -n "getHttpStatusCode" apps/api/v2 -l; rg -n "OAuth2ErrorService|handleClientError|\.getClient\(" apps/api/v2/src/modules/auth/oauth2 -l; ls apps/api/v2/src/modules/auth/oauth2/**/*.spec.ts 2>/dev/null

content.text:
Changing `getHttpStatusCode`'s signature could break 39 files: 9 that touch it directly and 30 that sit one call further out. I made no changes.

I started from `graphify affected` and then checked each file with `rg`. I dropped files that only import `isPrismaError` from the same module, since that function doesn't call `getHttpStatusCode`.

**Level 1: reference it directly (9 files)**
- `packages/lib/server/getServerErrorFromUnknown.ts` defines it and calls it in `getServerErrorFromUnknown`.
- `packages/platform/libraries/errors.ts` re-exports it, so the public export is also affected.
- Seven files call it:
  - `packages/trpc/server/lib/toTRPCError.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/oAuth/generateAuthCode.handler.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/oAuth/getClientForAuthorization.handler.ts`
  - `apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/route.ts`
  - `apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/refreshToken/route.ts`
  - `apps/api/v2/src/modules/auth/oauth2/services/oauth2-error.service.ts`
  - `apps/api/v2/src/modules/auth/oauth2/controllers/atoms-oauth2.controller.ts`

**Level 2: call a function that calls it (30 files)**
- **Callers of `getServerErrorFromUnknown` (24 files):**
  - Core and tRPC: `packages/lib/server/defaultResponder.ts`, `apps/web/app/api/defaultResponderForAppDir.ts`, `packages/trpc/server/onErrorHandler.ts`
  - Other web and package code: `apps/web/pages/api/integrations/[...args].ts`, `packages/emails/templates/_base-email.ts`, `packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts`, `packages/app-store/stripepayment/lib/PaymentService.ts`
  - App-store API handlers: `alby`, `btcpayserver`, `giphy`, `googlevideo`, `hitpay`, `jitsivideo`, `paypal`, `sylapsvideo`, `vital` and `wipemycalother`
  - Test: `packages/lib/server/getServerErrorFromUnknown.test.ts`
- **Callers of `convertErrorWithCodeToTRPCError` (2 files):** `errorConversionMiddleware.ts` and `toTRPCError.test.ts`.
- **Callers of the OAuth tRPC handlers (2 files):** `_router.tsx` and `generateAuthCode.handler.test.ts`.
- **Caller of the `oauth2-error.service.ts` methods (1 file):** `oauth2.controller.ts`.
- **Caller of the token route (1 file):** `token/__tests__/route.test.ts`.

Some neighbouring files only mention these names and wouldn't break:
- `calendar-subscriptions-cleanup/__tests__/route.test.ts` mocks `getServerErrorFromUnknown`, so it is only affected if the mock's return shape changes.
- `oauth2.module.ts` only registers the services.
- `packages/lib/errors.ts` only mentions the function in a comment.

Anything that calls `defaultResponder`, `defaultResponderForAppDir` or `onErrorHandler` is a third hop, so I left it out. The graph shows about 94 files in that wider set.
